results.title: Richland_County_Zoning20260623
results.description: All currently zoned jurisdictions within Richland County Ohio were combined into a single feature layer for ease of editing and version tracking to use in the production of zoning maps for individual jurisdictions. This single layer is also designed to be used on a web map with a parcel layer to identify the zoning designation of individual parcels by zoning inspectors and the public. This layer is for reference use only though and is not intended to be used for legal or engineering use unless verified with the local jurisdiction. Richland County Regional Planning Commission and its staff have made every effort to ensure the accuracy of this data but no warranties or promises are made to the correctness of this data. Where a zoning designation boundary falls along a parcel line, or the centerline of a railroad or very close to either it can be assumed that the delineation of boundaries is that parcel or center line, but it should be check with the specific jurisdiction that boundary is in.
results.snippet: This dataset is a combination of all zoned jurisdictions within Richland County, Ohio.
results.accessInformation: Richland County Regional Planning Commission, (K.E. McCartney and Associates for The City of Ontario)
results.licenseInfo: This data is public record and is free to use with the disclaimer that the map maintained by the zoning inspector of the respective jurisdiction is the official map for any and all official determinations of zoning designation or class. This data is provided as a public service by the Richland County Regional Planning Commission.
